sources.articleTitle: Safaricom Group net income rises 36% to KSh58.2 billion as Ethiopia operations near break-even
Safaricom Ethiopia posts 35.9pc profit growth as net earnings hit Sh58.1bn

headline: Safaricom Group Reports Significant Half-Year Profit Growth In 2026
seoTitle: Safaricom Group Half-Year Profit Grows 36 Percent
metaDescription: Safaricom Group recorded a 36 percent rise in net income to KSh 58.2 billion for the first half of the 2026/2027 fiscal year, driven by regional growth.
aiSummaryBullets: Safaricom Group reported a 35.9 percent increase in net income, reaching KSh 58.2 billion for the first half of the 2026/2027 financial year.
Group service revenue experienced a 13.1 percent rise, totaling KSh 226.1 billion during the reported period.
Financial results were supported by improved performance in Kenya and the progression of Ethiopian operations toward a break-even point.
aiContextParagraph: Safaricom PLC has released its financial results for the first half of the 2026/2027 fiscal year, reflecting a period of expansion and strengthened earnings across its primary markets. The telecommunications group observed a substantial net income growth of approximately 36 percent, culminating in KSh 58.2 billion. This financial momentum is attributed to a 13.1 percent increase in total group service revenue, which reached KSh 226.1 billion. A notable contributor to these figures is the company’s subsidiary, Safaricom Ethiopia, which reported marked profit growth as its operations move closer to achieving a break-even status. These reports highlight the overall financial health of the telecommunications provider as it continues to balance its long-established base in Kenya with its strategic expansion efforts within the Ethiopian market, marking a significant milestone for the firm's regional operational performance and profitability goals for the current fiscal cycle.
whyItIsViral: The story gained traction through coverage from two independent news outlets tracking the financial performance of a major telecommunications corporation.
